slices.title: Apply confirmed self-falsification fixes
slices.jtbd: When implementing the falsification fixes for this epic, I want to address all four confirmed findings in a single commit, so that the self-falsification cycle is unblocked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the employee dossier endpoints are accessed, When authenticating, Then HTTP 401 errors are resolved and Moodle SSO is used.
Given the Docker backup script is run, When initialized, Then it executes with correct underlying file permissions.
Given a PR is reviewed, When it contains out-of-scope changes, Then it is strictly rejected per refusal criteria without hallucinations.
Given the need for mandatory QA coverage, When verified, Then tests confirm all four findings are properly resolved without regressions.
